_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Reporting & Compliance consolidation: two custom pages under the existing top-level 'Compliance' group (label 'Reporting & Compliance', defined in the base manifest). The overview page renders the static ReportCatalogue as category-grouped cards with a per-card format picker + a Generate dialog that POSTs /api/reporting/generate; the generated-reports index lists the persisted GeneratedReport records with a download link. Both are type=custom (kind:page in src/registry.js) because neither the category-grouped card grid + generate dialog nor the download-link cell + three-facet filter row fits a built-in dashboard/index page type (ADR-024 / ADR-036). The menu leaves are merged into the existing 'Compliance' group by id (per mergeMenuItems in main.js); the stranded report leaves scattered across Belastingen / Bookkeeping / PublicSector / Purchasing are re-homed into this same group via src/menu-layout.json#relocations.

_menu_note: The 'Reporting & Compliance' top-level group is now a DIRECT LINK to the ReportingComplianceOverview cards page, with no sub-items. The route is set HERE (not in the base manifest) because main.js mergeMenuItems fills the base group's missing 'route' from this fragment, and the base-manifest consistency validator only resolves routes against base pages (the overview page is fragment-declared). The former 'Reports' + 'Generated reports' leaves are gone: the overview IS the reports page (a card per report) and links to the generated-reports index itself. nav-six-clusters (2026-08-20): the base group's id was renamed Compliance -> ReportingCompliance (REQ-NAVC-001 scenario 2 requires the old id not survive as a top-level entry) — this entry's id is updated to match, or mergeMenuItems would silently create an orphan second top-level group with no label.

pages.title: Reporting & Compliance
pages._note: Renders the STATIC ReportCatalogue as category-grouped cards, each with its own output-format picker and a Generate dialog that POSTs /api/reporting/generate. The catalogue is code, not an OpenRegister collection, so `type: index` has no config.register/config.schema to bind; and `type: dashboard` places widgets on a grid, not a per-card format selector plus a generate action. Grouping into 'Compliance' comes from the menu, not from the page.

pages.title: Generated reports
pages._note: Reads GET /api/reporting/generated rather than the objects API, because each row needs a download link to /api/reporting/download/{id} — a streamed Files-backed artefact, not an object field — and the three facets (category, period, administration) filter the fetched set in memory. `type: index` binds its rows to config.register + config.schema through the object store, so it can neither call that endpoint nor render the download cell. Grouping into 'Compliance' comes from the menu, not from the page.
